# Christian Lambillotte Poetry Website

> Recueil de poésie de Christian Lambillotte : entre questionnements existentiels et tendresse familiale, une œuvre poétique qui célèbre l'essentiel de la vie.

## About

This is the official poetry collection website of Christian Lambillotte, featuring French and Dutch poems exploring themes of life, humanity, family, love, and existential reflection.

## Biographical Information

**Christian Lambillotte** (1957-2026) was a son, brother, father, grandfather, scout, Freemason, writer, and amateur poet.

Born in Ghent (Gent), Belgium, he was passionate about Africa, to which he dedicated part of his professional life. He had a keen interest in languages and placed great importance on friendship, debate, and simple moments shared with those around him.

Although his literary work was not published during his lifetime, his writings are now carefully collected and preserved by his children.

## Content

The site includes:
- 7 French poems (poèmes français)
- 6 Dutch poems (Nederlandse gedichten)
- 1 Italian poem (poesia italiana)

Poems cover themes including:
- Life's journey and aging (30 ans en 30 lignes)
- Humanity and fraternity (L'essentiel retrouvé, Membre de l'humanité)
- Family and love (Anaïs)
- Existential dialogue (Le foetus et le squelette)
- Humor and celebration (Ode à la pomme de terre)
- War and loss (L'Orpheline de guerre)
- Moments of happiness (Een moment van diep geluk)
- Nature and reflection (Op de bergtop, Zandkorrel)
- Love and intimacy (De ring, Die kus)

## Languages

- Primary: French (Français)
- Secondary: Dutch (Nederlands)
- Tertiary: Italian (Italiano)

## Author

Christian Lambillotte (1957-2026) - Belgian poet from Ghent
Passionate about Africa, languages, and human connection
